note: Local rule-based knowledge only. No external AI, no API key, no real dispatch. All records are simulated and must be labelled as such in the UI.

summary_templates: A theft has been reported{loc}. The report describes a stolen item and a request for police guidance.
Theft report received{loc}. I have classified this as a police matter and prepared the steps usually taken after a theft.
intents.risk_assessment: Loss of property and a risk of the stolen item being misused. Do not chase or confront anyone.
recommended_actions: Move to a safe, public place
Note the time, place and a description of the person or vehicle if you saw one
Keep any bill, box number or IMEI details ready if the item is a phone
Report it at the nearest police station or call 112 if there is immediate danger
intents.voice_template: A theft has been reported. Please move to a safe place, note the time and details, and report it to police. Do not confront anyone.
intents.follow_up: Was anything else taken, and do you have a description of the person or vehicle?

summary_templates: A robbery has been reported{loc}. This is treated as a high-risk public-safety incident.
Robbery report received{loc}. Your safety comes first — property can be replaced, a confrontation cannot.
intents.risk_assessment: High risk of violence. The priority is personal safety, not recovery of property.
recommended_actions: Do not resist or chase the person
Move to a safe place as soon as it is safe to do so
Note clothing, height, direction of escape and any vehicle
Call 112 immediately if anyone is hurt or still in danger
intents.voice_template: A robbery has been reported. Do not resist or chase anyone. Move to safety and call 112 if there is danger.
intents.follow_up: Is anyone hurt, and is the person still nearby?

summary_templates: A road accident has been reported{loc}. The first concern is injuries and road safety.
Road accident report received{loc}. I have classified this as a traffic and medical-safety incident.
intents.risk_assessment: Risk of injury and of a second collision on a busy road. Keep the area clear if it is safe to do so.
recommended_actions: Do not move a seriously injured person unless there is immediate danger
Turn on hazard lights and keep other traffic away if you can do so safely
Note vehicle numbers and the exact road location
Call 112 if anyone is injured
intents.voice_template: A road accident has been reported. Keep the area safe, do not move seriously injured people unless there is danger, and call 112 if anyone is injured.
intents.follow_up: Is anyone injured, and how many vehicles are involved?

summary_templates: A traffic accident has been reported{loc}. Traffic flow and injured people are both a concern here.
Traffic accident report received{loc}. The road may be blocked and other drivers may not see the scene.
intents.risk_assessment: Blocked road and slow traffic increase the risk of further collisions.
recommended_actions: Keep a safe distance from the crash site
Use hazard lights and warn approaching traffic if safe
Note the road and direction of travel
Call 112 if anyone is injured or the road is fully blocked
intents.voice_template: A traffic accident has been reported. Keep a safe distance, warn other traffic if it is safe, and call 112 if anyone is injured.
intents.follow_up: Which road and direction is blocked, and is anyone injured?

summary_templates: A missing-person report has been received{loc}. Time and last-seen details matter most in the first hours.
Missing-person report received{loc}. I have prepared the details a police report usually asks for.
intents.risk_assessment: A missing person, especially a child or an elderly person, may be at risk from traffic, weather or confusion.
recommended_actions: Note the last place and time the person was seen
Note clothing, age and any medical needs
Check nearby familiar places and ask neighbours
Report it to the nearest police station, or call 112 if the person is a child or in danger
intents.voice_template: A missing-person report has been received. Note the last place and time seen, and report it to police. Call 112 if the person is a child or in danger.
intents.follow_up: Who is missing, how old are they, and where were they last seen?

summary_templates: Suspicious activity has been reported{loc}. The guidance is to observe from a safe distance, not to investigate.
Suspicious-activity report received{loc}. I have classified this as a public-safety observation.
intents.risk_assessment: Unknown intent. Observing from safety is safer than approaching.
recommended_actions: Stay in a well-lit, public place
Note appearance, clothing, vehicle number and direction
Do not approach or question the person
Call 112 if the behaviour turns threatening
intents.voice_template: Suspicious activity has been reported. Stay in a safe public place, note the details, and do not approach the person.
intents.follow_up: Can you describe the person or vehicle, and where exactly were they seen?

summary_templates: A public disturbance has been reported{loc}. Crowds can turn unsafe quickly, so distance is the safest step.
Public-disturbance report received{loc}. I have classified this as a public-order concern.
intents.risk_assessment: Crowd situations can escalate and block roads or emergency access.
recommended_actions: Move away from the crowd
Do not join the argument or try to intervene
Note the location and approximate number of people
Call 112 if anyone is hurt or property is being damaged
intents.voice_template: A public disturbance has been reported. Move away from the crowd and do not intervene. Call 112 if anyone is hurt.
intents.follow_up: How many people are involved, and is anyone hurt?

summary_templates: A harassment report has been received{loc}. You do not have to handle this alone, and you do not have to confront the person.
Harassment report received{loc}. I have prepared safe next steps and what to record.
intents.risk_assessment: Continued harassment can escalate. Safety and a clear record matter.
recommended_actions: Move to a public, well-lit place or a shop
Do not engage further if it is unsafe
Save messages, call records or photos if you have them safely
Call 112 if you feel threatened, or report it at a police station
intents.voice_template: A harassment report has been received. Move to a public safe place, save any evidence safely, and call 112 if you feel threatened.
intents.follow_up: Are you safe right now, and do you have any messages or details saved?

summary_templates: A personal-safety concern has been reported{loc}. The focus here is on getting to safety and staying reachable.
Personal-safety request received{loc}. Here are practical steps for this situation.
intents.risk_assessment: Feeling unsafe in a place, especially at night, is itself a safety signal to act on.
recommended_actions: Stay in lit, busy areas and avoid shortcuts
Share your live location with a trusted person if you can
Keep your phone charged and within reach
Call 112 if you are followed or threatened
intents.voice_template: A personal-safety concern has been reported. Stay in lit busy areas, share your location with someone you trust, and call 112 if you are threatened.
intents.follow_up: Where are you now, and are you alone or with someone?

summary_templates: A dangerous situation involving a weapon has been reported{loc}. This is treated as critical — distance and cover come first.
Weapon-related report received{loc}. Do not approach, do not investigate, and prioritise getting away safely.
intents.risk_assessment: Very high risk of serious harm. Immediate distance and an emergency call are the priority.
recommended_actions: Leave the area immediately if it is safe to do so
Do not approach the person or object
Call 112 as soon as you are safe
Do not touch any suspicious object
intents.voice_template: A dangerous situation has been reported. Leave the area if it is safe, do not approach anyone, and call 112 as soon as you are safe.
intents.follow_up: Are you in a safe place now, and can you describe the location?

summary_templates: A general police-assistance request has been received{loc}. Here is how a report is usually made.
General police request received{loc}. I can help you prepare the details for a report.
intents.risk_assessment: No immediate danger described. A clear written record still helps a police report.
recommended_actions: Write down what happened, when and where
Keep any photos, bills or messages related to it
Visit the nearest police station with an identity document
Call 112 only if there is immediate danger
intents.voice_template: A general police request has been received. Write down what happened, when and where, and visit the nearest police station with your details.
intents.follow_up: What happened, and when and where did it occur?

summary_templates: A possible medical emergency with chest pain has been reported{loc}. This is general emergency guidance only, not a diagnosis.
Chest-pain report received{loc}. Chest pain can be serious, so the guidance below is urgent and general — it is not a diagnosis.
intents.risk_assessment: Chest pain can indicate a serious heart problem. Time matters, and only a medical professional can diagnose it.
recommended_actions: Call 112 immediately
Keep the person resting, sitting or lying comfortably
Loosen tight clothing
Do not give food, drink or medicines unless a doctor has already advised them for this person
intents.voice_template: A possible medical emergency with chest pain has been reported. Call 112 immediately and keep the person resting. This is not a diagnosis.
intents.follow_up: How long has the pain lasted, and is there sweating, breathlessness or pain in the arm or jaw?

summary_templates: An unconscious person has been reported{loc}. This is general emergency guidance only, not a diagnosis.
Unconscious-person report received{loc}. Keep the person safe and get professional help quickly.
intents.risk_assessment: An unconscious person cannot protect their own airway. Professional help is needed urgently.
recommended_actions: Call 112 immediately
Check breathing without moving the person unnecessarily
If breathing and there is no spine injury risk, turn them gently onto their side
Do not give food or drink
intents.voice_template: An unconscious person has been reported. Call 112 immediately, check breathing, and do not give food or drink. This is not a diagnosis.
intents.follow_up: Is the person breathing, and how long have they been unconscious?

summary_templates: A road-accident injury has been reported{loc}. This is general first-aid guidance only, not a diagnosis.
Road-injury report received{loc}. The priority is to keep the person safe and get professional help.
intents.risk_assessment: Road injuries can include hidden bleeding or spine injury. Moving a seriously injured person can worsen it.
recommended_actions: Call 112 immediately
Keep the person still unless there is immediate danger such as fire
Apply gentle pressure with a clean cloth for visible bleeding
Keep the area clear for emergency access
intents.voice_template: A road-accident injury has been reported. Call 112, keep the person still unless there is danger, and apply pressure for bleeding with a clean cloth.
intents.follow_up: Is the person conscious and breathing, and where is the injury?

summary_templates: A bleeding emergency has been reported{loc}. This is general first-aid guidance only, not a diagnosis.
Bleeding report received{loc}. Stopping visible bleeding with pressure is the first step while help is on the way.
intents.risk_assessment: Heavy bleeding can become dangerous quickly. Pressure and professional help matter.
recommended_actions: Call 112 if bleeding is heavy or does not stop
Press firmly with a clean cloth or bandage
Keep the injured area raised if it is safe to do so
Do not remove an object stuck in a wound
intents.voice_template: A bleeding emergency has been reported. Press firmly with a clean cloth, and call 112 if bleeding is heavy or does not stop.
intents.follow_up: Where is the bleeding, and is it heavy or slow?

summary_templates: A burn has been reported{loc}. This is general first-aid guidance only, not a diagnosis.
Burn report received{loc}. Cooling and covering the burn, and avoiding home remedies on the skin, are the usual first steps.
intents.risk_assessment: Burns can worsen with delay and can become infected. Large, deep or facial burns need professional care.
recommended_actions: Cool the burn with clean, cool running water for at least 10 minutes
Cover loosely with a clean, non-sticky cloth
Do not apply toothpaste, butter or ice directly
Call 112 for large, deep, facial or breathing-related burns
intents.voice_template: A burn has been reported. Cool it with clean cool water, cover it loosely, and do not apply toothpaste or butter. Call 112 for large or deep burns.
intents.follow_up: How large is the burn, and which part of the body is affected?

summary_templates: Breathing difficulty has been reported{loc}. This is general emergency guidance only, not a diagnosis.
Breathing-difficulty report received{loc}. Breathing problems can worsen fast, so professional help is urgent.
intents.risk_assessment: Breathing difficulty can become life-threatening. It needs professional assessment, not a home diagnosis.
recommended_actions: Call 112 immediately
Help the person sit upright and loosen tight clothing
If the person is choking and cannot speak, encourage coughing if they can
Do not give food or drink while breathing is difficult
intents.voice_template: Breathing difficulty has been reported. Call 112 immediately and help the person sit upright. This is not a diagnosis.
intents.follow_up: Is the person able to speak or cough, and how long has this lasted?

summary_templates: Possible stroke warning signs have been reported{loc}. This is general emergency guidance only, not a diagnosis.
Stroke-sign report received{loc}. Sudden face, arm or speech changes need urgent professional assessment.
intents.risk_assessment: Stroke signs are time-critical. Only a hospital assessment can confirm a stroke.
recommended_actions: Call 112 immediately and note the time symptoms started
Keep the person resting and lying on their side if unconscious
Do not give food, drink or medicines
Do not wait to see if it passes
intents.voice_template: Possible stroke warning signs have been reported. Call 112 immediately and note when symptoms started. This is not a diagnosis.
intents.follow_up: When did the symptoms start, and which side is affected?

summary_templates: A general first-aid request has been received{loc}. This is general information only, not a diagnosis.
First-aid request received{loc}. Here is safe, general guidance for a minor situation.
intents.risk_assessment: Minor situations can still need professional care if they worsen. Watch for warning signs.
recommended_actions: Clean a minor cut with clean water and cover it
Rest and drink water for mild fever or headache, unless a doctor has advised otherwise
Watch for worsening pain, fever, breathing difficulty or bleeding
Seek a doctor or call 112 if symptoms worsen
intents.voice_template: A general first-aid request has been received. Clean minor cuts with water and cover them, rest, and seek a doctor if symptoms worsen. This is not a diagnosis.
intents.follow_up: What happened, and how long has it lasted?

summary_templates: An ambulance request has been received{loc}. This is a simulated request — no real ambulance has been sent.
Ambulance-assistance request received{loc}. In a real emergency, the number to call in India is 112.
intents.risk_assessment: Transport delay can worsen a medical emergency. A real call is needed for a real dispatch.
recommended_actions: Call 112 in a real emergency and give the exact location
Stay with the person and keep the entrance clear
Note the person's age, symptoms and any medicines
Do not move a seriously injured person unless there is danger
intents.voice_template: An ambulance request has been received. In a real emergency, call 112 with the exact location. This simulation has not sent any ambulance.
intents.follow_up: Where is the patient, and what are the main symptoms?

summary_templates: A residential fire has been reported{loc}. Leave the building — do not collect belongings and do not use lifts.
Residential-fire report received{loc}. Evacuation comes before anything else.
intents.risk_assessment: Fire and smoke spread fast in a building. Smoke inhalation is often more dangerous than flames.
recommended_actions: Leave immediately by the nearest safe exit
Do not use lifts
Stay low under smoke and close doors behind you if you can
Call 112 once you are outside and safe
intents.voice_template: A residential fire has been reported. Leave immediately, do not use lifts, and call 112 once you are outside and safe.
intents.follow_up: Is anyone trapped inside, and which floor is affected?

summary_templates: An electrical fire has been reported{loc}. Do not pour water on an electrical fire.
Electrical-fire report received{loc}. Power and water together are dangerous, so keep distance.
intents.risk_assessment: Electrical fires can restart and can electrify nearby objects. Professional fire crews are needed.
recommended_actions: Do not pour water on an electrical fire
Turn off the main power only if you can do so safely from a dry place
Leave the room and close the door if possible
Call 112 once you are safe
intents.voice_template: An electrical fire has been reported. Do not pour water on it. Leave the room if it is unsafe and call 112 once you are safe.
intents.follow_up: Where is the fire, and is the power still on?

summary_templates: A forest or field fire has been reported{loc}. Wind can change its direction quickly.
Forest-fire report received{loc}. Distance and wind direction matter more than trying to fight it.
intents.risk_assessment: Wildfires spread with wind and dry vegetation. Smoke can also affect breathing at a distance.
recommended_actions: Move away from the fire, upwind if possible
Do not try to fight a large fire yourself
Close windows and doors if smoke reaches your home
Call 112 and give the nearest road or landmark
intents.voice_template: A forest fire has been reported. Move away upwind, do not try to fight a large fire yourself, and call 112.
intents.follow_up: How large is the fire, and which direction is the wind blowing?

summary_templates: A gas leak has been reported{loc}. Do not switch any electrical device on or off — a spark can ignite gas.
Gas-leak report received{loc}. Fresh air and distance are the immediate steps.
intents.risk_assessment: Leaked gas can ignite from a spark and can cause breathing difficulty in an enclosed space.
recommended_actions: Do not switch lights, fans or phones on or off inside
Open doors and windows only if you can do so without a spark risk, then leave
Do not light a match or stove
Call 112 from outside the building
intents.voice_template: A gas leak has been reported. Do not switch anything electrical on or off, leave the building, and call 112 from outside.
intents.follow_up: Is the smell strong, and is anyone feeling dizzy or unwell?

summary_templates: A building rescue situation has been reported{loc}. Staying calm and giving an exact location helps rescuers.
Building-rescue report received{loc}. Do not re-enter a damaged building to search.
intents.risk_assessment: Collapsed or damaged buildings can shift further. Untrained rescue attempts can cause more harm.
recommended_actions: Do not re-enter a damaged or collapsed building
Call 112 and give the building name, floor and room if known
Shout or tap if you are trapped, and save phone battery
Keep others away from the damaged structure
intents.voice_template: A building rescue situation has been reported. Do not re-enter a damaged building. Call 112 with the exact building and floor.
intents.follow_up: How many people are trapped, and where exactly are they?

summary_templates: A vehicle fire has been reported{loc}. Fuel and tyres can make a vehicle fire spread and explode.
Vehicle-fire report received{loc}. Distance is safer than trying to save the vehicle.
intents.risk_assessment: Vehicle fires can flare suddenly from fuel, tyres and batteries.
recommended_actions: Move at least 30 metres away
Do not open the bonnet or try to remove belongings
Warn other road users if it is safe
Call 112 and give the road and direction
intents.voice_template: A vehicle fire has been reported. Move at least 30 metres away, do not open the bonnet, and call 112.
intents.follow_up: What type of vehicle is it, and is anyone trapped inside?

summary_templates: Smoke has been reported{loc}. Smoke can be dangerous even without visible flames.
Smoke report received{loc}. Treat smoke as a fire warning until it is checked.
intents.risk_assessment: Smoke inhalation and low visibility are the main risks, even in a small fire.
recommended_actions: Leave the smoky area and stay low
Close doors behind you if you can
Do not use lifts
Call 112 if smoke is thick, spreading or you cannot find its source
intents.voice_template: Smoke has been reported. Leave the smoky area, stay low, do not use lifts, and call 112 if smoke is thick or spreading.
intents.follow_up: Where is the smoke coming from, and how thick is it?

summary_templates: A flood-rescue situation has been reported{loc}. Rising water and strong currents are the main dangers.
Flood-rescue report received{loc}. Do not walk or drive through moving water.
intents.risk_assessment: Flood water can hide drains and debris and can rise faster than expected.
recommended_actions: Move to the highest safe floor or roof if water is rising
Do not walk or drive through moving water
Call 112 and give the exact address and number of people
Keep a charged phone and a light with you if possible
intents.voice_template: A flood-rescue situation has been reported. Move to high ground, do not walk through moving water, and call 112 with the exact address.
intents.follow_up: How many people are trapped, and how deep is the water?

summary_templates: A fire-safety request has been received{loc}. Here are practical prevention and escape steps.
Fire-safety request received{loc}. A planned escape route matters more than any equipment.
intents.risk_assessment: Most home fires start in kitchens and from electrical faults. Prevention and an escape plan reduce risk.
recommended_actions: Keep a clear escape route from every room
Test smoke alarms monthly and keep a fire extinguisher accessible
Do not overload sockets or leave cooking unattended
Practise a family escape plan and a meeting point outside
intents.voice_template: A fire-safety request has been received. Keep escape routes clear, test smoke alarms, and do not overload sockets.
intents.follow_up: Is this for a home, office or school?

summary_templates: Flooding has been reported{loc}. Avoid flooded roads and watch for rising water.
Flood report received{loc}. I have classified this as a disaster and public-safety incident.
intents.risk_assessment: Flood water can hide open drains and can rise quickly after heavy rain.
recommended_actions: Do not walk or drive through flooded roads
Move valuables and documents to a higher place if safe
Keep drinking water and a charged phone ready
Call 112 if water enters homes or anyone is trapped
intents.voice_template: Flooding has been reported. Do not walk or drive through flooded roads, and call 112 if water enters homes or anyone is trapped.
intents.follow_up: How deep is the water, and is it still rising?

summary_templates: Heavy rainfall has been reported{loc}. The main risks are waterlogging, weak structures and slippery roads.
Heavy-rainfall report received{loc}. Here are precautions for this weather.
intents.risk_assessment: Heavy rain can lead to flooding, falling branches and power problems, even before water is visible.
recommended_actions: Avoid low-lying roads and underpasses
Stay indoors during lightning and strong wind
Keep phones charged and drinking water ready
Call 112 if water rises or a tree or pole falls
intents.voice_template: Heavy rainfall has been reported. Avoid low-lying roads, stay indoors during lightning, and call 112 if water rises.
intents.follow_up: How long has it rained, and is any road already waterlogged?

summary_templates: An electricity disruption has been reported{loc}. This is a simulated complaint — no real utility has been contacted.
Electricity report received{loc}. Here are safe steps while power is out.
intents.risk_assessment: Power cuts can affect medical devices, food storage and street safety at night.
recommended_actions: Do not touch fallen wires or damaged poles
Keep a torch ready and avoid candles near curtains
Unplug sensitive electronics to avoid surge damage
Report it to your local electricity office, or call 112 if a wire is down and dangerous
intents.voice_template: An electricity disruption has been reported. Do not touch fallen wires, and report it to your local electricity office. Call 112 if a wire is down.
intents.follow_up: How large is the affected area, and is any wire down?

summary_templates: A water-supply issue has been reported{loc}. This is a simulated complaint — no real utility has been contacted.
Water-supply report received{loc}. Here are steps while supply is disrupted.
intents.risk_assessment: Disrupted supply can affect drinking water and hygiene, especially in hot weather.
recommended_actions: Store clean drinking water in covered containers
Do not drink discoloured water without boiling it first
Note the affected streets for a complaint
Report it to your local water office
intents.voice_template: A water-supply issue has been reported. Store clean drinking water in covered containers, and report it to your local water office.
intents.follow_up: Which streets are affected, and since when?

summary_templates: A road blockage has been reported{loc}. The road may be unsafe for other drivers as well.
Road-blockage report received{loc}. I have classified this as an infrastructure and traffic-safety issue.
intents.risk_assessment: Blocked roads can delay emergency access and cause further accidents.
recommended_actions: Do not try to move large debris or a fallen pole yourself
Warn other drivers if it is safe to do so
Use an alternative route
Call 112 if the blockage is dangerous or someone is injured
intents.voice_template: A road blockage has been reported. Do not move large debris yourself, use an alternative route, and call 112 if it is dangerous.
intents.follow_up: What is blocking the road, and is anyone injured?

summary_templates: A natural disaster has been reported{loc}. Stay away from damaged buildings and falling objects.
Natural-disaster report received{loc}. The guidance below is general safety information.
intents.risk_assessment: Aftershocks, falling debris and damaged structures can follow the first event.
recommended_actions: Move to an open area away from buildings and poles if it is safe
Do not re-enter damaged buildings
Keep a charged phone and drinking water ready
Call 112 if anyone is trapped or injured
intents.voice_template: A natural disaster has been reported. Move to an open area away from buildings if it is safe, and call 112 if anyone is trapped or injured.
intents.follow_up: What happened, and is anyone trapped or injured?

summary_templates: An infrastructure problem has been reported{loc}. This is a simulated complaint — no real department has been contacted.
Infrastructure report received{loc}. Here is how such a complaint is usually recorded.
intents.risk_assessment: Infrastructure faults can become traffic or safety problems if left unreported.
recommended_actions: Note the exact road and landmark
Take a photo from a safe place if you can
Avoid the damaged section, especially at night
Report it to your local municipal office
intents.voice_template: An infrastructure problem has been reported. Note the exact road and landmark, and report it to your local municipal office.
intents.follow_up: Which road and landmark, and how large is the damage?

summary_templates: A public-safety alert request has been received{loc}. Here is general safety guidance for the area.
Public-safety request received{loc}. Stay informed through official local channels.
intents.risk_assessment: General alerts help people avoid an area, but they do not replace a direct emergency call.
recommended_actions: Avoid the affected area if possible
Follow official local announcements
Keep phones charged and emergency numbers ready
Call 112 for any immediate danger
intents.voice_template: A public-safety alert request has been received. Avoid the affected area, follow official announcements, and call 112 for immediate danger.
intents.follow_up: What is the alert about, and which area does it cover?
